<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">B.</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">None of the categories in
Part&#8239;A of this Section&#8239;I is applicable to the Investor.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">II.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><U>DETERMINATION
OF STATUS AS A RESTRICTED PERSON</U></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Unless the Investor has
checked one or more of the boxes in Part&#8239;A of Section&#8239;I above, the Investor should check each box in Part&#8239;A of this
Section&#8239;II that is applicable to the Investor (and, if the Investor checks the box for item&#8239;4, 5, 6 and/or 12, provide the
additional information requested) or, if none of the categories in Part&#8239;A is applicable, the Investor should check the box in Part&#8239;B
of this Section&#8239;II.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">A.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Investor:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&#8239;is
a FINRA member or other broker-dealer (other than a broker-dealer described in item 14 of this Part&#8239;A of Section&#8239;II).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">2.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is
an officer, director, general partner, associated person<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>3</SUP></FONT>
or employee of a FINRA member or other broker-dealer (other than a limited business broker-dealer<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>4</SUP></FONT>).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is
an agent of a FINRA member or other broker-dealer (other than a limited business broker-dealer) that is engaged in the investment banking
or securities business.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt; width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font-size: 1pt">&#8239;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>3</SUP> A person &ldquo;associated with&rdquo;
a FINRA member or broker-dealer includes a sole proprietor, partner, officer, director, or branch manager of such member or broker-dealer,
or a natural person occupying a similar status or performing similar functions, or a natural person engaged in the investment banking
or securities business who is directly or indirectly controlling or controlled by a FINRA member or broker-dealer and also includes a
natural person who is registered or has applied for registration under the rules of FINRA.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>4</SUP> A &ldquo;limited business broker-dealer&rdquo;
is a broker-dealer whose authorization to engage in the securities business is limited solely to the purchase and sale of investment
company/variable contracts securities and/or direct participation program securities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"></P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt; width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font-size: 1pt">&#8239;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>5</SUP> As used herein, the term &ldquo;immediate
family&rdquo; includes parents, mother-in-law or father-in-law, spouse, brother or sister, brother-in-law or sister- in-law, son-in-law
or daughter-in-law, children and any other person to whom the person provides material support as defined in footnote 6 below.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>6</SUP> For this purpose, the term &ldquo;material
support&rdquo; means the direct or indirect provision of more than 25% of a person&rsquo;s income in the prior calendar year. Members
of the immediate family living in the same household are deemed to be providing each other with material support.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><I>Proprietary, Trade Secret and Confidential</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">7.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">has
the authority to buy or sell securities for a bank, savings and loan institution, insurance company, investment company, investment advisor,
or collective investment account.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>7</SUP></FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">8.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is
an immediate family member of a person described in item&#8239;7 above and such person described in item&#8239;7 above materially supports,
or receives material support from, such immediate family member.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">9.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is
a person (other than a sovereign entity)<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>8</SUP></FONT> listed, or required
to be listed, in Schedule A of a Form&#8239;BD (other than with respect to a limited business broker-dealer), except persons identified
by an ownership code of less than 10%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">10.</FONT> &#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is
a person (other than a sovereign entity) listed, or required to be listed, in Schedule B of a Form&#8239;BD (other than with respect
to a limited business broker-dealer), except persons whose listing on Schedule B relates to an ownership interest in a person listed
on Schedule A of such Form&#8239;BD identified by an ownership code of less than 10%.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>7</SUP> As used herein, the term &ldquo;collective
investment account&rdquo; means any hedge fund, investment partnership, investment corporation, or any other collective investment vehicle
that is engaged primarily in the purchase and/or sale of securities. The term does not include an investment club where a group of individuals
pool their money and are collectively responsible for investment decisions, or a family investment vehicle beneficially owned solely
by one or more of the following persons: immediate family members, &ldquo;family members&rdquo; within the meaning of the Investment
Advisers Act and rules or regulations thereunder, or &ldquo;family clients&rdquo; within the meaning of the Investment Advisers Act and
rules or regulations thereunder.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>8</SUP> As used herein, the term &ldquo;sovereign
entity&rdquo; means a sovereign nation or a pool of capital or an investment fund or other vehicle owned or controlled by a sovereign
nation and created for the purpose of making investments on behalf of or for the benefit of the sovereign nation. As used herein, the
term &ldquo;sovereign nation&rdquo; means a sovereign nation or its political subdivisions, agencies or instrumentalities.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">IV.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">DETERMINATION
OF STATUS AS A COVERED PERSON</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><B>Unless the Investor has
checked one or more of the boxes numbered 1 through 10 in Part&#8239;A of Section&#8239;I above, the Investor should check each box in
Part&#8239;A, Part&#8239;B and Part&#8239;C of this Section&#8239;IV that is applicable to the Investor (and, if the Investor checks
the box for an item, provide the additional information requested) or, if none of the categories in Part&#8239;A, Part&#8239;B or Part&#8239;C
is applicable, the Investor should check the box in Part&#8239;D of this Section&#8239;IV.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">A.</TD><TD>The Investor:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;1.
is an executive officer or director of a public company.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>10</SUP></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-indent: 0.75in">If yes, name of company: <U>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;2.
is an executive officer or director of a covered non-public company.<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>11</SUP></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-indent: 0.75in">If yes, name of company: <U>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.75in; text-indent: -0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;3.
is a person materially supported<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>12</SUP></FONT> by an executive officer
or director of a public company or a covered non-public company.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-indent: 0.75in">If yes, name of company: <U>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1in; text-indent: -0.5in">Persons described in 1, 2 or 3 above
are referred to as &quot;Covered Persons.&quot;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt; width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font-size: 1pt">&#8239;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>10</SUP> As used herein, a &ldquo;public
company&rdquo; is any company that has a class of securities registered under Section 12 of the Exchange Act, or any company that files
periodic reports pursuant to Section 15(d) of the Exchange Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>11</SUP> As used herein, a &ldquo;covered
non-public company&rdquo; means any non-public company, except for an unaffiliated charitable organization, satisfying any of the following
three criteria:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-indent: 0.25in; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">(a) income of at least $1
million in the previous fiscal year or in two of the three previous fiscal years and shareholders&rsquo; equity of at least $15 million;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in; text-align: justify">(b) shareholders&rsquo;
equity of at least $30 million and an operating history of at least two years; or</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.25in; text-align: justify">(c) total assets and total
revenue of at least $75 million in the latest fiscal year or in two of the three most recent fiscal years.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>12</SUP> For this purpose,
&ldquo;material support&rdquo; means directly or indirectly providing more than 25% of a person&rsquo;s income in the prior calendar
year. Persons living in the same household are deemed to be providing each other with material support.</P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

used without definition in this Exhibit&#8239;shall have the respective meanings specified in the attached Subscription Agreement.</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Fund from time to time
may be required to provide certain information related to FINRA, FINRA associations and affiliations of the Fund and its Partners in
connection with public offerings involving the Fund&rsquo;s portfolio companies under various rules&#8239;adopted by FINRA. As a result,
the Fund is seeking certain information regarding the FINRA associations and affiliations of the Investor.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Investor has completed
this <U>Exhibit&#8239;I</U> pursuant to Section&#8239;2(t)&#8239;of the attached Subscription Agreement. The Investor represents and warrants
that the information provided by the Investor in this <U>Exhibit&#8239;I</U> is true and accurate.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">The Investor acknowledges
and agrees that, as part of the Adviser&rsquo;s administration and operation of the Fund, the Adviser may disclose the information provided
by the Investor in this Questionnaire to the extent the Adviser determines in good faith that such disclosure is necessary or advisable,
or has been reasonably requested, in connection with the public offering of a Portfolio Company.</P>

Investor:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">1.</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is a FINRA member.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 1.5in">Name of FINRA member: <U>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</U></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">2.</FONT>
&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is an associated person<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>1</SUP></FONT>
of a FINRA member.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 1.5in">Name of FINRA member: <U>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;</U></P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt; width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font-size: 1pt">&#8239;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>1</SUP>.A person &ldquo;associated with&rdquo;
a FINRA member means a sole proprietor, partner, officer, director, or branch manager of such member, or other natural person occupying
a similar status or performing similar functions, or a natural person engaged in the investment banking or securities business who is
directly or indirectly controlling or controlled by a FINRA member (including, without limitation, as a result of being an employee of
the FINRA member, whether or not any such person is registered or exempt from registration with FINRA under the by-laws, or rules of
FINRA) and also includes a natural person who is registered or has applied for registration under the rules of FINRA.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><I>Proprietary, Trade Secret and Confidential</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">is
an immediate family member<FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><SUP>2</SUP></FONT> of a person described in item
2 above.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0 0pt 1.5in; text-align: justify">Name of FINRA member with respect to
which the person specified in item&#8239;2 is an associated person:&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>2</SUP>.As used herein, the term &ldquo;immediate
family&rdquo; means parents, mother-in-law or father-in-law, spouse, brother or sister, brother-in-law or sister-in- law, son-in-law
or daughter-in-law, and children, except any person (other than a spouse or child) who does not live in the same household as, have a
business relationship with, provide &ldquo;material support&rdquo; (as defined below) to or receive material support from, the person
described in item 2 above. In addition, &ldquo;immediate family&rdquo; includes any other person who either lives in the same household
as, provides material support to, or receives material support from, the person described in item 2 above. The term &ldquo;material support&rdquo;
includes, without limitation, the direct or indirect provision of more than 25% of a person&rsquo;s income in the prior calendar year.&#8239;</P>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Wingdings">&#168;</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">B.</FONT>&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The

<!-- Field: Rule-Page --><DIV STYLE="margin-top: 3pt; margin-bottom: 3pt; width: 25%"><DIV STYLE="border-top: Black 1pt solid; font-size: 1pt">&#8239;</DIV></DIV><!-- Field: /Rule-Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><SUP>3</SUP> As used herein, the term &ldquo;affiliate&rdquo;
means a &ldquo;company&rdquo; (as defined below) which controls, is controlled by or is under common control with a FINRA member. The
term &ldquo;affiliate&rdquo; is presumed to include, but is not limited to, the following: (i) a company is presumed to control a FINRA
member if the company beneficially owns 10% or more of the outstanding voting securities of a FINRA member which is a corporation, or
beneficially owns a partnership interest in 10% or more of the distributable profits or losses of a FINRA member which is a partnership;
(ii) a FINRA member is presumed to control a company if the FINRA member and persons associated with the FINRA member beneficially own
10% or more of the outstanding voting securities of a company which is a corporation, or beneficially own a partnership interest in 10%
or more of the distributable profits or losses of a company which is a partnership; (iii) a company is presumed to be under common control
with a FINRA member if: (a) the same natural person or company controls both the FINRA member and such company by beneficially owning
10% or more of the outstanding voting securities of such member or company which is a corporation, or by beneficially owning a partnership
interest in 10% or more of the distributable profits or losses of such FINRA member or company which is a partnership; or (b) a person
having the power to direct or cause the direction of the management or policies of the FINRA member or the company also has the power
to direct or cause the direction of the management or policies of the other entity in question. Notwithstanding the foregoing, none of
the following shall be presumed to be an affiliate of a FINRA member: (i) an investment company registered with the SEC pursuant to the
1940 Act; (ii) a &ldquo;separate account&rdquo; as defined in Section 2(a)(37) of the 1940 Act; (iii) a &ldquo;real estate investment
trust&rdquo; as defined in Section 856 of the Code; (iv) a &ldquo;direct participation program&rdquo; as defined in FINRA Rule 2310(a);
and (v) a corporation, trust, partnership or other entity issuing financing instrument-backed securities which are rated by a nationally
recognized statistical rating organization in one of its four highest generic rating categories. As used herein, &ldquo;company&rdquo;
means a corporation, a partnership, an association, a joint stock company, a trust, a fund, or any organized group of persons whether
incorporated or not; or any receiver, trustee in bankruptcy or similar official or any liquidating agent for any of the foregoing, in
his capacity as such.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: right"><B><U>APPENDIX A</U></B></P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B><U>EXEMPT PERSONS</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">1.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;An
investment company registered under the 1940 Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">2.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;A
common trust fund or similar fund as described in Section&#8239;3(a)(12)(A)(iii)&#8239;of the Exchange Act, if the fund (a)&#8239;has investments
from 1,000 or more accounts, and (b)&#8239;does not limit beneficial interests in the fund principally to trust accounts of Participating
Members.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">3.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;An
insurance company general, separate or investment account, if (a)&#8239;the account is funded by premiums from 1,000 or more policyholders,
or, if a general account, the insurance company has 1,000 or more policyholders; and (b)&#8239;the insurance company does not limit the
policyholders whose premiums are used to fund the account principally to Participating Members, or, if a general account, the insurance
company does not limit its policyholders principally to Participating Members.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">4.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;A
publicly traded entity (other than a broker-dealer or an affiliate of a broker-dealer where such broker-dealer is authorized to engage
in public offerings of securities either as a selling group member or underwriter) that: (a)&#8239;is listed on a national securities
exchange or (b)&#8239;is a foreign issuer whose securities meet the quantitative designation criteria for listing on a national securities
exchange.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">5.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;An
investment company organized under the laws of a foreign jurisdiction if (a)&#8239;the investment company is listed on a foreign exchange
or authorized for sale to the public by a foreign regulatory authority, (b)&#8239;no person owning more than 5% of the shares of the investment
company is a Participating Member, the investment company has 100 or more direct investors, or the investment company has 1,000 or more
indirect investors, and (c)&#8239;the investment company was not formed for the specific purpose of permitting Restricted Persons to invest
in new issues.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">6.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;An
ERISA benefits plan that is qualified under Section&#8239;401(a)&#8239;of the Code and such plan is not sponsored solely by a broker-dealer.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">7.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;An
employee retirement benefits plan organized under and governed by the laws of the United States or of a foreign jurisdiction, provided
that such plan or family of plans (a)&#8239;has, in aggregate, at least 10,000 plan participants and beneficiaries and $10 billion in
assets, (b)&#8239;is operated in a non-discriminatory manner insofar as a wide range of employees, regardless of income or position, are
eligible to participate without further amendment or action by the plan sponsor, (c)&#8239;is administered by trustees or managers that
have a fiduciary obligation to administer the funds in the best interests of the participants and beneficiaries, and (d)&#8239;is not
sponsored solely by a broker-dealer.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">8.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;A
state or municipal government benefits plan that is subject to state or municipal regulation.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in">9.&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;&#8239;A
tax exempt charitable organization under Section&#8239;501(c)(3)&#8239;of the Code.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: center; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><B>Global Fund Privacy Notice</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Third Point Private Capital Income Fund (the &ldquo;Fund&rdquo;)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; background-color: white"><B>About this privacy notice</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Fund is a data controller,
financial institution, or business, respectively, in respect of your personal data for the purposes of applicable data protection laws,
such as the European Union&rsquo;s General Data Protection Regulation (&ldquo;GDPR&rdquo;), and the GDPR as incorporated into and retained
by, the laws of the United Kingdom (the &ldquo;UK GDPR&rdquo;), the Data Protection Act (2021 Revision) of the Cayman Islands, the Data
Protection Act, 2021 of the British Virgin Islands, the Data Protection Bailiwick of Guernsey, 2017 (the &ldquo;DPLs&rdquo;), the Gramm-Leach-Bliley
Act (&ldquo;GLBA&rdquo;), and the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020, and
any regulations promulgated thereunder (the &ldquo;CCPA&rdquo;, the DPLs, the GLBA, the UK GDPR, together with the GDPR, collectively,
the &ldquo;Data Protection Laws&rdquo;). The Fund is responsible for ensuring that it uses your personal data in compliance with such
Data Protection Laws.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Fund will generally
process personal data provided to it in connection with a potential investment or consummated investment in the Fund and in furtherance
of its legal obligations under applicable law. State Street Bank and Trust Company (&ldquo;State Street&rdquo;), the Fund&rsquo;s sub-administrator,
will process personal data provided to it in connection with an investment in the Fund. This privacy notice should be read in conjunction
with the Data Privacy Notice of IFS, which can be accessed at <U>https://www.statestreet.com/disclosures-and-disclaimers/privacy</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">This privacy notice
applies to you to the extent your personal data is subject to any of the Data Protection Laws and (i)&#8239;you have been or are contacted
by the Fund in connection with an investment in the Fund, (ii)&#8239;in certain circumstances, your personal data has been provided to
the Fund by another person (such as where you are a director, partner, trustee, employee, agent or direct or indirect owner of an investor)
in connection with an investment in the Fund or (iii)&#8239;in certain circumstances, the Fund otherwise has or uses your personal data.
This privacy notice sets out the bases on which personal data about you will be processed by the Fund.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><I>If you are an individual</I>,
please take the time to read and understand this privacy notice.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><I>If you are an entity
or other body</I>, you must provide a copy of this privacy notice to all individuals whose personal data you have provided (or will provide)
to the Fund or its sub-administrator. These will include, for example, individuals whose information has been provided in relation to
know-your-client procedures or the automatic exchange of information for tax purposes (<I>e.g.</I>, under FATCA or CRS), individuals
who are authorised to give instructions regarding your investment, and individuals who have communicated with the Fund and/or its sub-administrator.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Contacting the Fund</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">If you would like further
information on the collection, use, disclosure, transfer or other processing of your personal data or the exercise of any of the rights
listed below, please contact Investor Relations at +1 (212) 715-6707, at ir@thirdpoint.com, or via our toll-free number +1 (844) 373-7646.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Fund processes the
following types of personal data about you:</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Information provided to the Fund by
                                            you or (if different) the investor: This includes your name and address, e-mail address,
                                            contact details, date of birth, gender, nationality, photograph, signature, social security
                                            number, occupational history, job title, income, assets, account balance, other financial
                                            information, bank details, investment and transaction history, financial situation, tax residency
                                            and tax identification information. Such information might be provided in a subscription
                                            agreement or in other documents (in connection with your subscription, continued investment
                                            or at other times), face-to-face, by telephone, by email or otherwise.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            generates: This includes information relating to your (or, if different, an investor&rsquo;s)
                                            emails (and related data), call recordings and website usage data.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Information that the Fund obtains from
                                            other sources: This includes information obtained for the purpose of the Fund&rsquo;s know-your-client
                                            procedures (which include anti-money laundering procedures, counter-terrorist financing procedures,

                                            intermediaries.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Your personal data may

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><I>Proprietary, Trade Secret and Confidential</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Lawful grounds for
processing</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Subject to the Data
Protection Laws, the Fund processes your personal data in these ways on the following lawful grounds:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">If you are the potential investor, you
                                            may enter into an investment contract with the Fund and some processing will be necessary
                                            for the performance of such contracts, or will be done at your request prior to entering
                                            into such contracts.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Processing may be necessary to discharge
                                            a relevant legal or regulatory obligation in the EEA, the UK, the British Virgin Islands,
                                            or the Cayman Islands, as applicable.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The processing will, in all cases, be
                                            necessary for the legitimate business interests of the Fund, the Investment Manager, the
                                            Fund&rsquo;s sub-administrator, or other service providers, such as:</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">carrying out the ordinary or reasonable
                                            business activities of the Fund, the Investment Manager, the Fund&rsquo;s sub-administrator
                                            or other service providers, or other activities previously disclosed to the Fund&rsquo;s
                                            investors or referred to in this privacy notice;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(ii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">ensuring compliance with all legal
                                            and regulatory obligations and industry standards, and preventing fraud;</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(iii)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">establishing, exercising or defending
                                            legal rights or for other purposes relating to legal proceedings; and</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.75in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(iv)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">ensuring the security of information
                                            systems.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The Fund will only process your personal
                                            data in pursuance of its legitimate interests where the Fund has considered that the processing
                                            is necessary and, on balance, the Fund&rsquo;s legitimate interests are not overridden by
                                            your legitimate interests, rights or freedoms.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Subject to the Data Protection Laws,
                                            in respect of any processing of sensitive personal data falling within special categories,
                                            such as any personal data relating to the political opinions of a politically exposed person,
                                            the processing will be necessary for reasons of substantial public interest.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><I>Proprietary, Trade Secret and Confidential</I></P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Disclosure of your
personal data to third parties</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Fund may from time
to time, for the purposes described above, disclose your personal data to the following categories of third parties: (a)&#8239;the Investment
Manager and its affiliates, (b)&#8239;the Fund&rsquo;s sub-administrator and its affiliates, (c)&#8239;professional advisors such as law
firms and accountancy firms, (d)&#8239;other service providers of the Fund, the Investment Manager and the Fund&rsquo;s sub-administrator,
including technology service providers, (e)&#8239;counterparties, (f)&#8239;courts and regulatory, tax and governmental authorities, and
(g)&#8239;other third parties with your consent. Some of these persons will process your personal data in accordance with the Fund&rsquo;s
instructions as data processors or service providers under applicable Data Protection Laws and others will themselves be responsible
for their use of your personal data as data controllers or businesses under such laws.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">We do not disclose nonpublic
personal information about our investors or former investors to any nonaffiliated parties except as otherwise stated in this privacy
notice. The disclosures referenced above are for Third Point related business purposes, such as to process your transactions, maintain
your accounts, provide you with account statements, and to respond to court orders and legal investigations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">You may, in certain
instances, be able to opt-in to receive text messages should you so choose. Mobile opt-in data collected will not be shared with nonaffiliated
third-parties for marketing purposes.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>How we protect your
personal data</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Third Point employs
a layered approach to cybersecurity using multiple overlapping policies, procedures, and technologies to insure the confidentiality,
integrity, and availability of our most sensitive assets. We employ many administrative, technical, and physical controls for defense-in-depth.
For additional information please reference the overview of cybersecurity policies and controls (Appendix E) in the Third Point DDQ.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Necessity of personal
data for an investment in the Fund</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The provision of certain
personal data is necessary for shares in the Fund to be issued to any investor and for compliance by the Fund and its service providers
with certain legal and regulatory obligations. Accordingly, if certain personal data is not provided when requested, a subscription for
shares might not be accepted or shares might be compulsorily redeemed.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Retention of personal
data</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">How long the Fund holds
your personal data for will vary. The retention period will be determined by various criteria, including the purposes for which the Fund
is using it (as it will need to be kept for as long as is necessary for any of those purposes) and legal obligations (as laws or regulations
may set a minimum period for which the Fund has to keep your personal data).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Former investors</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">We maintain personal
data of former investors and apply the same policies and procedures that apply to our current investors.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Individuals Located
in (as Residents) the European Union, European Economic Area, United Kingdom, Cayman Islands, the British Virgin Islands or the Bailiwick
of Guernsey</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">This section applies
to the extent you have rights under GDPR, UK GDPR, or the DPLs.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Transfers of your
personal data outside the European Economic Area</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Your personal data may
be transferred to and stored by persons outside the European Economic Area (the &ldquo;EEA&rdquo;) or the UK, and in particular may be
transferred to and stored by affiliates or service providers of the Fund or the Fund&rsquo;s sub-administrator outside the EEA or the
UK.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Where personal data
is transferred outside the EEA or the UK by the Fund, the Fund will take appropriate safeguards with respect to such transfer. For example,
the country to which the personal data is transferred may be approved by the European Commission or the UK Government, the recipient
may have agreed to model contractual clauses approved by the European Commission or the UK Government that oblige them to protect the
personal data.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">You can obtain more
details of the protection given to your personal data when it is transferred outside the EEA or the UK by contacting the Fund using the
details set out under &ldquo;Contacting the Fund&rdquo; above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Transfers of your
personal data outside the Cayman Islands</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Your personal data may
also be transferred to and stored by persons outside of the Cayman Islands. Where this takes place, we will ensure that the transfer
is subject to appropriate safeguards or is otherwise permitted by the DPL or other applicable law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">You can obtain more
details of the protection given to your personal data when it is transferred outside the Cayman Islands by contacting the Fund using
the details set out under &ldquo;Contacting the Fund&rdquo; above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Transfers of your
personal data outside the British Virgin Islands</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Your personal data may
also be transferred to and stored by persons outside of the British Virgin Islands. Where this takes place, we will ensure that the transfer
is subject to appropriate safeguards or is otherwise permitted by the DPL or other applicable law.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">You can obtain more
details of the protection given to your personal data when it is transferred outside the British Virgin Islands by contacting the Fund
using the details set out under &ldquo;Contacting the Fund&rdquo; above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Your rights</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">Depending on where you
are located and subject to the Data Protection Laws, you may have a number of legal rights in relation to the personal data that the
Fund holds about you. These rights include the following:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(a)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to obtain information regarding
                                            the processing of your personal data and access to the personal data that the Fund holds
                                            about you.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">In some circumstances, the right to receive
                                            some personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and the right
                                            to request that the Fund transmits that data to a third party where this is technically feasible.
                                            Please note that this right only applies to personal data which you have provided to the
                                            Fund.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(c)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to request that the Fund rectifies
                                            your personal data if it is inaccurate or incomplete.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to request that the Fund erases
                                            your personal data in certain circumstances. Please note that there may be circumstances
                                            where you ask the Fund to erase your personal data but the Fund is legally entitled to retain
                                            it.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to object to, and the right to request
                                            that the Fund restricts, its processing of your personal data in certain circumstances. Again,
                                            there may be circumstances where you object to, or ask the Fund to restrict, its processing
                                            of your personal data but the Fund is legally entitled to continue processing your personal
                                            data or to refuse that request.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(f)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to stop or not begin direct marketing.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(g)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to be informed of a personal data
                                            breach (unless the breach is unlikely to be prejudicial to you).</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(h)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to lodge a complaint with the data
                                            protection regulator (details of which are provided below) if you think that any of your
                                            rights have been infringed by the Fund.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; background-color: white"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">(i)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The right to be free from unlawful discrimination
                                            for exercising your data protection rights.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><I>Proprietary, Trade Secret and Confidential</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&#8239;</P>



<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">You can exercise your
rights by contacting the Fund using the details set out under &ldquo;Contacting the Fund&rdquo; above. You can find out more information
about your rights by contacting an EU data regulator (<U>https://edpb.europa.eu/about-edpb/about-edpb/members_en</U>), or about the rights
you may have under the UK GDPR by contacting the UK&rsquo;s Information Commissioner&rsquo;s Office, or by searching their website at
ico.org.uk. For more information about the rights you may have under the Cayman Islands DPL, please contact the Cayman Islands Data Protection
Ombudsman whose details are available at www.ombudsman.ky. The office of the British Virgin Islands Information Commissioner has not
yet been established, but this privacy notice will be updated on its establishment. For more information about the rights you may have
under the Bailiwick of Guernsey DPL, please contact the Office of the Data Protection Authority whose details are available at <U>https://www.odpa.gg</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Automated decision-making</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The Fund will not take
decisions producing legal effects concerning you, or otherwise significantly affecting you, based solely on automated processing of your
personal data, unless the Fund has considered the proposed processing in a particular case and concluded in writing that it meets the
applicable requirements under the DPLs.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Individuals Located
in (as Residents) California</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">If you are a California
resident, this section provides you with information concerning your rights under the CCPA. Please note that these disclosures and the
rights described below do not apply to information collected, processed, used, and used by the Fund under the GLBA (and its implementing
regulations) or the California Financial Privacy Act.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

our business and commercial purposes in the past 12 months. Not all categories have been collected or disclosed for every individual.</P>

social security number, driver&rsquo;s license number, passport number, or other similar identifiers.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">We only use and disclose
sensitive personal information as reasonably necessary (i)&#8239;to perform our services requested by you; (ii)&#8239;to prevent, detect,
and investigate security incidents; (iii)&#8239;to detect, prevent, and respond to malicious, fraudulent, deceptive, or illegal conduct;
(iv)&#8239;to verify or maintain the quality and safety of our services, (v)&#8239;for compliance with our legal obligations; (vi)&#8239;to
our service providers who perform services on our behalf; and (vii)&#8239;for purposes other than inferring characteristics about you.
We do not use or disclose your sensitive personal information other than as authorized by section 7027 of the CCPA regulations (Cal.
Code. Regs., tit. 11 &sect; 7027 (2022)).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><B>Sources and purposes
for collecting personal information</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; background-color: white">The categories of sources
from which we collect personal information and the business and commercial purposes for which we collect and disclose the personal information
are set forth above in the sections titled &ldquo;Personal data that the Fund processes&rdquo; and &ldquo;Uses of your personal data,&rdquo;
respectively.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#8239;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
